/bin/zsh -lc 'bun build src/cli.ts --target=bun --outfile /tmp/taskboard-cli-check.js
case_db=$(mktemp /tmp/taskboard-case.XXXXXX.json)
rm "$case_db"
TASKBOARD_FILE="$case_db" bun run src/cli.ts add --title '"'  Preserved title  ' --tags Alpha,alpha,beta --due 2024-02-29 >/tmp/taskboard-add.json
TASKBOARD_FILE=\""'$case_db" bun run src/cli.ts list --overdue 2024-03-01 >/tmp/taskboard-list.json
before_db=$(cksum "$case_db")
if TASKBOARD_FILE="$case_db" bun run src/cli.ts add --title bad --due 2024-02-30 >/tmp/taskboard-error-out.json 2>/tmp/taskboard-error-err.txt; then exit 1; fi
after_db=$(cksum "$case_db")
[ "$before_db" = "$after_db" ]
printf '"'{not json' > \""'$case_db"
if TASKBOARD_FILE="$case_db" bun run src/cli.ts list >/tmp/taskboard-malformed-out.json 2>/tmp/taskboard-malformed-err.txt; then exit 1; fi
rg -x '"'\\{\"error\":\"database is malformed\"\\}' /tmp/taskboard-malformed-out.json
rm \""'$case_db" /tmp/taskboard-cli-check.js
'
